caption: The drawing depicts the upper portion of a building’s facade rendered in grayscale, possibly through a stippling or dot method. The composition features a long balcony bordered by a metal railing with a pointed arch design, extending horizontally across the image. There are four sets of French doors or windows with shutters behind the balcony, each door or window segment having vertical slats visible through the partly open shutters. A section of the building’s roof is visible at the top, showing architectural details such as exposed rafters, decorative corbels, and two roof structures: a small dormer with an arched window on the left side and a rectangular chimney toward the center. Light and shadow create contrast on the building’s white or grayish exterior walls, with strong shadows under the roofline and balcony. The overall color scheme is exclusively shades of gray, achieved through dense dot patterns and line work.
title: Wrought Iron Balcony Railing
